Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The players are out in the middle. Shai Hope and Kyle Mayers are the openers for West Indies. Hasan Ali to start with the ball.
...The Chase...

Right then! We saw the spinners getting the purchase and Pakistani spinners will have the talk now. West Indies failed to handle them last time around but they will hope to showcase a better batting performance this time. Say tuned as the chase is coming up next.

Shadab Khan is in for a chat. He says that it was a pressure situation and he only aimed to play normal till the 40th over. Further adds this pitch was much better for batting, but in the end, cricket is a funny game and you never know what happens. Mentions that he never knew Pooran could bowl as well and he took a four-fer. Adds due to his injuries he could not bowl longer spells but currently, he seems to be in a better condition and hope it changes this time.

It is the same story for West Indies throughout the series, spinners have been incredible but the seamers are the ones who fail to ride the momentum. A similar thing happened, the pacers failed to get the breakthrough earlier but once spinners, not one we would see often but Nicholas Pooran, got into the attack. He came out of the syllabus for Pakistan as he ran through the lineup and ended with four wickets.  Akeal Hosein was once again economical but other than that, the Windies failed to handle the final phase as Pakistan scored most of their runs at the backend.

From reeling at 117/5 at one stage, Pakistan's lower order has done an incredible job to reach what could prove to be a match-winning score. Pakistan were off to a good start with Fakhar Zaman and Imam-ul-Haq but once Zaman fell, the wickets started falling like a pack of cards and the hosts were in a spot of bother. After a bit of delay due to a dust-storm, it was the stand between Shadab Khan and Khushdil Shah of 84 that helped Pakistan get back on track. Shah fell in the process but Shadab made sure to give the finishing touches and helped his team reach a defendable score.
So, 52 runs from the last five overs and it is an excellent recovery from Pakistan in this final phase. Shadab Khan particularly was the architect for his team who did all the repair work.
Full length, down leg. Dahani moves to that side and flicks it to wide long on for two runs. PAKISTAN END THEIR INNINGS AT 269/9.
A brilliant yorker this time, right on the money. Ali digs it out solidly and gets across for a single.
It is overpitched, on off. Dahani connects and works it to long off for a single.
Full length, wide outside off. Ali fends it to mid off for a quick single.
Very full, on leg. Dahani hits it down the ground for one.
Shahnawaz Dahani is the last man in.

OUT! TIMBER! A valiant innings by Shadab Khan comes to an end. Jayden Seales goes full and straight at the stumps. Shadab Khan shuffles across and tries to scoop it away but misses. The ball goes through to disturb the stumps. Jayden Seales sends back the man in-form.
A slower one now, into the ribs. Ali ducks and hooks it away to deep square leg for two more. That means Khan will take the strike in the final over.
FOUR! Hasan Ali is off the mark with a boundary. It is full and wide outside off. Hasan Ali reaches out and chips it over backward point for four runs.
Hasan Ali walks out.

OUT! CHOPPED ON! Keemo Paul gets rid of Wasim here. Pakistan lost their eighth wicket now. It is a length ball, outside off. Wasim tries to heave across the line. The ball takes the inside edge and rattles the stumps. Elation for Paul.
FOUR! Mohammad Wasim joins the party now. It is slower one, around middle and leg. Wasim hangs back and pulls it to deep square leg for a boundary. West Indies are all over the place at the moment.
WIDE! Full length, wide outside off, even outside the tramline as the umpire signals a wide.
BYE! A slower bouncer, outside off. Khan shuffles across and tries to scoop it away but fails to get any blade on it. The keeper fumbles and the batters collect a leg bye.
Full length and into the leg side. Khan flicks it to deep square leg. He wants two and gets two. Solid running.
Shadab Khan wisely takes a single and keeps the strike for the penultimate over. Full and on leg. Khan eases it to long on for a single.
Good length, outside off. Khan punches it through covers for a brace.
LEG BYE! Mohammad Wasim successfully gets on the other end. It is full, around off. Wasim tries to ramp it away but misses. The ball rolls out off his pads. They collect a leg bye.
A perfect yorker, just outside off. Khan dabs it to backward point for one.
Full length, on middle and leg. Khan flicks it to wide long on. Pooran sprints to his right and puts in a dive just before the ropes to save a boundary. They take two.
SIX! BANG! Short and punished! Back of a length, on off. Khan stands tall and smokes it over the wide long on fence for a biggie. He moves to 78.
Play and a miss! A dot to end the over. A slower ball this time. Full and outside off. Wasim swings hard but fails to connect.
Full length, angled down leg. Khan tucks it to mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Up and over! Shadab Khan is on a roll! It is a short ball, wide outside off. Khan stands tall and smacks it over covers for a boundary.
Almost a perfect yorker, on off. Khan drills it to long on for a brace. This is really good running.
A short ball, on off. Wasim pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Full length, on off. Wasim blocks it out.
11 off the over! Hosein fires one around leg. Khan looks to pull but misses. An appeal follows for LBW but that was angling down.
Full and outside off. Khan drives it with soft hands to long off and gets a brace.
Short and way outside off, Khan cuts it but straight to point.
SIX! Shadab giving the finishing touches now! Flighted, full and outside off. Khan steps across and gets low to smash it over long on for a biggie.
Short and way outside off. Khan shuffles and cuts it to deep point. Takes two with ease.
Tad short and on off, eased down to mid-wicket for a single.
Mohammad Wasim is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Good catch by Akeal Hosein! Paul serves it full and just outside off. Nawaz looks to go downtown but hits off the outer half of the bat and to covers where Akeal Hosein back pedals and takes a sharp catch over his head. The umpire just checks if Keemo Paul overstepped but he is all okay with the line. Mohammad Nawaz makes his way to the pavilion.
Commentary.Howout: c Akeal Hosein b Keemo Paul

Commentary.Commentary: Wide! This is way outside off. Left alone.
Hits the hard length and tails it on middle. Khan pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
This is full and way outside off. Nawaz drives it to deep cover for a single.
Length ball, slanting on middle. Nawaz lofts it towards long on for a brace.
A slower bumper, outside off. Khan waits and taps it to backward point for a single.
A slower length ball, outside off. Nawaz hits it to deep point for a single.
Full ball, angling on middle. Nawaz turns it to mid-wicket for a single.
Tad short and outside off, Khan pulls it to long on for one.
Darted on the pads, flicked to short fine leg for a single.
Slower in the air, flatter and on middle. Nawaz bunts it to square leg.
Pushes it quicker on the pads. Nawaz skips down and tucks it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up, on middle. Nawaz pushes it to mid on.
Tossed up, on off, Khan drives it back to the bowler. A decent over from Walsh to finish off his spell.
Too full and on middle, pushed to long off for a single.
Googly again, fuller and just outside off. Nawaz looks to defend as he prods but misses.
Shorter, outside off, turning away. Nawaz knocks it to covers.
Full toss on off, pushed to long off for a single.
Fifty for Shadab Khan! He came at a time when his team was in a difficult position! Looking all set to finish it off! Length ball, outside off. Khan strokes it to deep point for a couple of runs.
Tossed up, on middle. Khan works it to long on for a single.
On off, pushed out for one.
Mohammad Nawaz is the new man in.

OUT! TIMBER! Akeal Hosein has the last laugh here. It is fuller and on off. Shah dances down the track but this time ends up playing all around it. The ball goes through to lit up the stumps. Akeal Hosein breaks a crucial partnership here.
FOUR! Incredible shot! Full, on off. Shah uses his feet and lofts it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
A single now as this is worked to sweeper cover.
Touch full and outside off. Khan cuts it to backward point for a couple.
Powerplay 3! Now, 5 fielders are allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the last over.
Full and outside off. Shah works it towards mid on yet again. A great over by Walsh comes to an end.
Three dots on the trot! Much flatter and on off. Shah stays back and punches it to mid on.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Shah leans in and works it towards mid on.
Tossed up, full and on off. Shah plays it back to the bowler.
On off, pushed to covers for one.
Fuller and on leg. Khan gets into an awkward position but does enough to get a blade on it. The batters run a couple as the ball goes to fine leg.
FOUR! Deft touch! Very clever shot by Khushdil Shah. Back of a length, outside off. Shah waits for it and dabs it down to third man for a boundary. A great over for Pakistan, 11 runs off it.
Width on offer this time. A short ball, wide outside off. Khan cuts it hard to deep point and collects a run.
Touch shorter, around off. Shah taps it to covers and scampers across for a quick single.
FOUR! Put away nicely! A full-length ball, on off. Shah hangs back and lofts it towards long off for a boundary. Shah gets his first one of the innings.
Back of a length, on off. Khan swivels on the back foot and pulls it to deep square leg. Keemo Paul misfields in the deep but the batters could only take a single.
It is a length ball, on off. Khan blocks it out watchfully.
Floated and full, around off. Shah pushes it through covers for a brace.
Fuller, on off. Shah gets it back to the bowler.
On off, Khan pushes it through covers for one.
SIX! BANG! The crowd errupts. It is tossed up, full and outside off. Shadab Khan stays back and smokes it over the cover fence for a biggie.
Fuller and on middle. Shah eases it to long on for one.
Single now as this is worked down to long off.
A length ball, outside off. Shah stays back and punches it to covers but straight to the fielder. A good over by Paul comes to an end.
Good length, on off, defended out.
On a length, around off. Shah remains solid in his defense.
Full length, on off. Shah gets on his front foot and pushes it to mid on.
Another length ball, on off. Khan fends it to covers for a quick run.
A length ball, on off. Shah works it to covers for a single.
Fuller, on off. Shah eases it to long on for another single. The 50 runs stand is up between the two.
A short ball, outside off. Khan stays back and cuts it to deep point for a single.
Darted on the pads, Khan nudges it to square leg.
Full and on off. Khan pushes it back to the bowler.
On off, blocked out.
Low full toss, on off. Khan slogs it to deep square leg. The fielder in the fumbles. Two runs taken.
Some of the West Indies players are wearing a mask due to the storm earlier.
Fuller and at the stumps. Shah eases it to long on for one. The umpire signals a no ball, as there weren't the required number of fielders inside the inner circle.
Bangs a bouncer, outside off. Khan half-pulls it but fails to connect.
Around off, on a length. Khan knocks it to point again.
Short of a length, around off. Khan drops it to point. Khan runs into the danger area and the umpire gives him a caution.
FOUR! Played it fine! On a length and just outside off. Khan waits and dabs it fine to third man for a boundary.
A length ball, outside off. Khan drives it past point for a couple of runs.
Paul goes short and on off. Khan stays back and blocks it out to covers.

We are back. We have lost a couple of overs but thankfully the dust storm has subsided. There will be only 48 overs to play now. Shadab Khan and Khushdil Shah are back on the crease. It will be Keemo Paul to start with his second spell.

UPDATE - 7.35 pm IST (2.05 pm GMT) - We are back after a bit of delay. Hang on, the players are out in the middle but the visibility is quite poor and everyone is walking back to the pavilion AGAIN. So, the restart has been delayed. Stay tuned for further updates.

UPDATE - 7 pm IST (1.30 pm GMT) - A dust storm has arrived at Multan. The umpires have asked the players to walk down to the pavilion and rightly so as the visibility is not good enough to continue. It's quite windy as well. Let's hope this is a short break.

Leg bye! An arm ball, full and on leg. Khan makes room and fails to flick it away. He gets hit on the pads and West Indies appeal for it but the umpire shakes his head. They think to review this but that was clearly going down.
Full and on off, pushed to long off for a single.
On middle. Fuller. Shah keeps it out.

What a terrific effort from Seales! This is full and on middle. Khan hits it straight down the ground, high in the air. Seales runs across from long off and almost puts out a blinder but sees he was about to touch the ropes so parries the ball away from the boundary ropes, all in the air.
Flatter and on off, worked to point.
An in-drifter, around off. Khan looks to push it but gets an inside edge to the leg side.

Drinks! West Indies are on the front foot right now but the stand between Khan and Shah is 35 now so, West Indies need to make sure the tail doesn't wag much and bundle Pakistan out near the 200-run mark.
Short and outside off, cut away to deep point for a single.
A single as this is hit to long off.
Flighted, too full and outside of off. Khan drives it to deep cover for a single.
FOUR! Too short on this occasion from Walsh, around middle. Khan clears his front leg and pulls it in the gap, to mid-wicket for a boundary,
Tossed up on middle, drilled down to long on for a single.
Full and outside off, slower. Khan drives it to deep cover for a run.
Just a single! End of a remarkable bowling performance from Nicholas Pooran! He ends with four wickets. Full and on middle, drilled down to long on for one.
Full and on off, pushed through covers for a single.
On middle. Kept out.
Almost a five-fer for Pooran! Slower, full and around off. Khan swings across but mistimes it and the fielder at mid-wicket dives to his left but fails to carry it.
Short again, around off. Khan pulls it to deep mid-wicket where Keemo Paul runs to his left and cuts it out. Two runs.
Shorter, slower and outside off. Shah slaps it to deep point for a single.
Hosein gets the extra bounce again. This is short and outside off. Khan looks to push it on the back foot but misses and it passes the off pole by a whisker.
Too full and on middle. Khan plays it back to the bowler.
Fuller and on middle. Shah bunts it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Too full and on off. Shah reverse hits it past backward point for a brace.
Tossed up on middle. Blocked out by Shah.
Shorter and around off, spinning in. Shah rocks back and looks to tuck but gets an inside edge and it lobs to mid-wicket. Falls safely.
FOUR! Slightly quicker from Pooran and he is punished! This is on a length and outside off. Khan waits and punches it past point for a boundary.
A full toss, on middle, diipping one. Khan punches it to the left of mid-wicket who does well to cut it out.
Flatter and on off. Khan taps it near point and looks for a quick single but is sent back.
On middle. Blocked out.
Full again on off. Khan drives it straight to mid off.
Full and on middle. Blocked out.
Full and on off, Khan pushes it to long off for one more.
Slants a full ball on off. Khan keeps it out.
Shorter and outside off. Khan cuts it to point where Shamarh Brooks makes a good stop.
Darted on the pads, Shah helps it to fine leg for a single.
Tossed up, outside off. Khan plays with the spin through covers for a single.
Too short and outside off. Khan cuts it but straight to point.
A loopy ball on middle. Eased down to long on for a single.

Good effort in the deep! Flatter and outside off. Khan slaps it to deep point where the fielder runs to his right, dives and keeps it down to two. The umpire checks it and that is a superb effort from the man there. Keeping the pressure intact.
Full and on off, pushed to covers.

Three wides! What was that delivery! This is full and down the leg side. Khan waits and clears his front leg to heave it but the ball gets dead off the deck and the keeper fails to collect it. It goes past leg slip for two runs. .
On middle, Khan waits and tucks it to mid-wicket.
Tosses it up nicely on middle. Khan defends on the front foot.
Outside off, cut to point for a single.
Full again, Khan works it to covers.
Full and on off, pushed to covers.
Extra bounce this time, shorter and around off. Khan looks to push on the up but edges it to first slip who collects it on a bounce.
Flatter and on middle. Shah rocks back and nudges it behind square on the leg side for a single.
On middle, flicked to mid-wicket.
Quicker, full and on middle. Shah reverse sweeps it to short third man.
Tossed up around off, angling in. Shah clips it off the inside edge and to square leg for a single.
On middle, punched to long on for a single and Khan is off the mark.
Shadab Khan walks in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Nicholas Pooran is running through the Pakistan batting lineup! The skipper has turned up in this match. Pooran drops it short and angles it across, outside off, the ball stays very low off the deck. Mohammad Rizwan shuffles across to cut it but the ball dips and takes the bottom edge on its way to the keeper. A huge appeal for caught behind but nothing was given. Nicholas Pooran is quick to take the review. Hope is confident about it. UltraEdge shows a spike as the ball passes the bat and Mohammad Rizwan has to walk back. Out it is!
Commentary.Howout: c Shai Hope b Nicholas Pooran

Commentary.Commentary: Flights it too much, full and on off. Shah drills it to long off for a single.
Slower and angling around off. Shah pushes it back to the bowler.
Tossed up on off. Blocked out.
Tossed up on middle. Rizwan defends off the inner half of the bat to mid-wicket. No run there. The spinners have certainly made Pakistan play on their songs.
Shorter and around off, hit to covers.
Tossed up, around off, it spins away. Rizwan hangs back and taps it to point.
Tosses it up, around off. Shah pushes it to long on for a single.
Slightly short and on middle. Shah tucks it to square leg.
Tossed up on middle, flicked to mid-wicket.
Wide! Flatter and on middle, spinning away from the batter. Shah leaves it alone for a wide.
A flighted full ball, on off, pushed to long off for a single.
Khushdil Shah walks out. Two slips in place for him.

OUT! TAKEN! Another one bites the dust! Nicholas Pooran has three now! He is certainly enjoying his bowling right now! A soft-dismissal! Shorter and outside off. Haris tries to cut it hard but gets an outside edge to backward point where Akeal Hosein dives to his right and takes a sharp tumbling catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Akeal Hosein b Nicholas Pooran

Commentary.Commentary: On middle. Haris keeps it out.
Mohammad Haris comes in.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! Nicholas Pooran has struck again! This is out of the syllabus for Pakistan! Pooran flights this one, full and outside off. Imam was looking for a big shot and this time tries to sweep but gets a top edge and it balloons over the keeper. Shai Hope turns around and pouches it with ease. So, the set batter goes now and Pakistan need a big partnership.
Commentary.Howout: c Shai Hope b Nicholas Pooran

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, slower again on middle. Imam comes down the track and blocks it.
Slower in the air, full and outside off. Rizwan drills it to long on for a single.
Tossed up on middle. Imam hits it to mid-wicket.
Another single as Rizwan punches it to covers.
Flatter and on middle, spinning in. Imam flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Misfield! Tossed up on off. Rizwan drives it to covers where the man lets it go through his hands for a single.
On a fuller-length, on off. Rizwan leans and blocks it.
An arm ball, tossed up, on middle. Rizwan blocks it on the off side.
Akeal Hosein is into the attack now. One slip in place.
Tossed up, just around off. Blocked out.
Pooran drags his length ball, outside off. Rizwan plays it to deep cover for a single.
Too much flight this time. Imam works it to long on for a run.
Angles a full ball across the batter. Rizwan eases it to long on for one.
A flighted full toss, outside off. Imam hits it to long off for a single.
Too short and around off, pulled away to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! A welcome boundary! Flatter and outside off, width there. Imam-ul-Haq hammers it past point for a boundary.
Too full and on off, a leggie, pushed back to Walsh.
A googly, on the shorter side. Imam manages to dab it away very late to third man and the batters collect a brace. 100 up for Pakistan.
Slightly short and outside off. Rizwan slaps it to sweeper cover for a single.
A googly on middle. Rizwan tucks it to mid-wicket and Walsh runs across to collect.
Pushed quicker on the pads. Imam flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short again, quicker this time. Rizwan tucks it to mid-wicket.
Drops it short and outside off, cut through covers for a single.
A flighted delivery, outside off. Rizwan waits and drives it through point for a single.
Tosses it up, outside off. Rizwan drives it to mid off this time.
Tossed up on middle. Blocked out on the front foot.
Full and on middle, worked to square leg for one.

Fifty for Imam-ul-Haq! Seven consecutive fifty plus score in ODI! He needs to hand in till the deep now and look for a triple-digit as he missed out last time. Tossed up, outside off. Imam skips down and pushes it to long off for a single.
Floats a full ball, on leg. Rizwan turns it to long on for a single.
Fuller and outside off. Rizwan drives it through covers for a couple of runs. He is off the mark.
Quicker through the air and on middle, tucked to mid-wicket.
Wide! Drifts this one down the leg side. Rizwan misses his flick.
Mohammad Rizwan is the new man in.

What a wicket this is for West Indies! A huge one as they have got the big fish for a timid score. A rare low score here for the skipper! This is short and around middle and leg, it rushes through to Azam who quickly gets on the back foot and looks to flick it but misses and gets hit on the pads. A huge shout for LBW but not given! West Indies take the review. Height might be a big factor. UltraEdge shows nothing on it. Ball Tracking shows three reds and Babar Azam is a goner. West Indies right on top here.
Tossed up, full and on off. Azam drills it back to the bowler.
Full and on middle. Imam flicks it to deep mid-wicket and comes back for the second.
Shorter and on middle. Azam chips it past mid-wicket to get off the mark with a single.
Babar Azam is the new batter in.

OUT! TIMBER! Nicholas Pooran strikes and opens the wicket column. Yet again, Fakhar Zaman gets the start but fails to convert into a big one. Pooran flights this one, full and angling around off. Zaman who was looking so good till now, tries to sweep this one but mistimes it completely. The ball is slower through the air and goes past the bat to rattle the stumps. First international wicket for Pooran
Slower from Pooran, outside off. Zaman pushes it to point.
A full toss, around off. Imam whips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Slightly short and outside off. Zaman strokes it to point for a single.
Tossed up, on middle. Imam wrists it to square leg. West Indies should turn towards their best bowler now, Akeal Hosein!
On middle, on a length. Imam bunts it to mid-wicket.
SHorter and on the pads, flicked past square leg for a single.
A single on the other side as Imam pushes it to long on.
Around off. Zaman takes the charge as he comes down the track and eases it to long off for a single.
Slower through the air and on the pads, on a length. Zaman misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. An appeal for LBW but that was always going down.
Length ball on off, knocked to point for one more. Zaman will retain the strike.
FOUR! These two just changing their gears now! This is full and on off. Zaman loves to play square of the wicket and he sweeps this nicely to square leg for a boundary.
Shorter and on middle, tucked to square leg for a single.
A single as this is hit to deep point.
Flatter and outside off. Zaman dabs it to short third man.
Full and outside off, driven through diving cover for a single.
On a length and on the pads, flicked to mid-wicket.
Flights a full ball on off, pushed to mid off for a single.
Quicker this time, around off. Imam rocks back and keeps it out.
FOUR! Smashed away! A loopy ball, full and on middle. Imam puts his skates on and drives it through covers for a boundary.
Tossed up on middle. Zaman fends it away to deep mid-wicket for one.
Very full and on middle, Imam smashes it wide of long on for one more.
Tossed up, on off, drilled down to long on for a single.
Some turn there! This one lands on off and turns away. Imam drops it to covers.
Tailing on the pads. Zaman bunts it past square leg for a run.
On middle, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Drops it short, around off, doesn't bounce much. Zaman hits it to long on for one.
Flatter and outside off. Imam slaps it to deep cover for a single.
A surprise change as Nicholas Pooran will bowl now.
A googly, on a length, Zaman reads and pushes it back to Walsh.
Pushed quicker through the air, around off. Zaman punches it back to the bowler.
Drifting on the pads, flicked to square leg for a single.
Shorter and on off. Zaman taps it around the corner on the off side for a single.
Flighted ball, on the pads. Zaman tickles it to short fine leg. Imam wants a quick single but Zaman is ball watching at the other end.
Too full and on middle, eased down to long on for one.
Full and outside off. Zaman pushes it to cover. Imam was out of his crease but the fielder opts not to throw the ball.
On a length and tailing on middle. Kept out.
Slanting on the pads, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
pitched up, around off. Imam slices his push to point.
Full, shaping in, on middle, Imam makes room and drives it to mid off.
Length ball, slanting on off. Imam hangs back and knocks it to point.
Powerplay 2! Now, 4 fielders will be allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over!
Short and outside off, cut away past point for a couple of runs. 13 runs off the over. Pakistan are off to a good start.
FOUR! Second in the over! Too full and on middle. Zaman sweeps it past backward square leg for a boundary.
A loopy ball on off, Imam works it to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Nicely flighted this one, full and on off. Imam-ul-Haq comes down the track and lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
Another single as Zaman hits this full ball wide of long on.
Flatter and around off. Imam tucks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Hayden Walsh is into the attack.
A bit of mix-up but a single is taken easily. On a length and on middle. Imam flicks it to mid-wicket for a run.
On top of off, stroked to point.
An off-cutter and on middle, fuller, Zaman nudges it square of the wicket on the leg side for a single.
Now Fakhar Zaman solidly blocks this length ball to mid off.
FOUR! First shot of aggression from Zaman! On a length and on middle. Fakhar Zaman comes down the track and whacks it past mid-wicket for a boundary.
On a length and on middle. Zaman clips it to mid-wicket.
Pitched up and on off, pushed to mid off.

SIX! First of the innings and it comes from the bat off none other than Imam! Short and on middle, it rushes to Imam-ul-Haq but he quickly gets back and pulls it all the way over square leg for a biggie.
On the pads, Imam-ul-Haq hits it back to Paul.
Very full and on middle. Imam eases it to mid on.
Full and on off, drilled to mid off.
Short in length and outside off. Zaman punches off the back foot to point where Hayden Walsh excellently dives to his left and certainly saves a boundary. A single.
Full and on leg, Zaman turns it in front of square on the leg side for one.
On a length and around off. Zaman taps it in front of covers and thinks of a single but denies it.
On the pads, it stays low, this is pulled to fine leg for a single.
Touch fuller and on middle, it skids through. Imam whips it to mid-wicket.
On a length and on middle, nudged to square leg.
FOUR! Classic drive! Shepherd serves a loose delivery, full and outside off. Imam-ul-Haq leans and caresses it through covers for a boundary.
Romario Shepherd to bowl now.
Short of a length, outside off. Fakhar punches it to point.
FOUR! Good shot! Too full, straight on the pads. Zaman flicks it past square leg for a boundary.
Tight from Paul on the stumps. Zaman blocks it out to mid on.
Around off, fuller, forced to mid off.
Through the gap! Length ball, outside off. Zaman punches it through cover-point for a brace.
Length balll on middle. Zaman punches it to mid on.
On the pads, tucked to square leg. So, four dots after the boundary. West Indies will be happy with the start.
This is full and on off. Imam drives it straight and the bowler does well to get a hand to it and half-stop it allowing mid on to clear it up.
On a length, around middle and off. Defended out.
Length and on off, played to mid off.
FOUR! Seales tries a widish yorker but serves a half volley, outside off. Imam drives it square of the wicket on the off side for a boundary.
No ball! A full toss around the waist. Imam-ul-Haq bends his back and lets it through. The umpire immediately signals a no ball. Free Hit coming up.
Full and outside off. Imam-ul-Haq mistimes his driven to covers.
Outside off, knocked to point. Just two runs off it.
Fakhar Zaman is struggling with his timing! Touch fuller and slanting around middle and leg. Zaman looks to work on the leg side but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Slants a length ball on middle. Zaman keeps it out.
Outside off, on a length. Zaman punches it to point.
Length and outside off, driven to mid off where a fumble allows for a couple of runs.
A length ball, around off. Zaman is a touch late to defend and it takes the inside edge and deflects onto the pads.
On middle. Blocked out.
Wide! Shorter and down the leg side. Imam shoulders arms to it.

Good follow-up delivery from Seales! A length ball, around the 5th stump line. Imam steps across and looks to defend but the ball whizzes past the inside edge and goes to the keeper. The replay shows there was an edge but the keeper dived to his right and failed to hold on.
FOUR! Beautiful timing! Seales serves a full ball, around off. Imam brings a straight bat down and drives it past mid off and the ball races away into the fence.
Length ball, around off. Blocked out solidly.
Angles a length ball, just outside off. Imam covers his stumps and lets it through.
On the pads, tucked to mid-wicket.
Drop and run! Around off, this is pushed to covers and Imam calls for a quick single. The fielder collects the ball and hits at the bowler's end but Imam was well in. A single.
Length and on off. Defended to point where a fumble happens but no run is taken.
Wide! Short but down the leg side. Left alone.
Full and on middle at 137 kph. Imam gets his bat in front of the body and pushes it to mid on.
Touch full and on off, pushed to covers.
FOUR! Imam-ul-Haq and Pakistan are underway! Hard length ball, down the leg side. Imam clips it away to fine leg for a boundary.
Ouchh! This is on a length and on middle, steep bounce and Imam-ul-Haq shuffles across and looks to block it but the ball bounces and hits him on the body.
Who will bowl from the other end? It is Keemo Paul!

A maiden over to start with! A bit of mix-up on this occasion. On a length and on off. Zaman drives it through covers and calls for a quick single. The mid off fielder runs across and cuts it off and Imam sends Zaman back. No harm was done in the end.
Goes wide of the crease and slants a full ball on off. Zaman looks to drive but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
On a length and around middle at 134 clicks. Zaman stays back to pull it but misses and gets hit high on the pads. Good start by Seales.
Drags his length back and targets the middle stump. Zaman tucks it to mid-wicket.
This is full and on the pads. Zaman fails to flick it away and gets hit on the pads. Was pitching outside leg.
A full ball, around off, hint of away swing. Zaman pushes it back to Seales.

We are all set for the action. The West Indies players are out in the middle. Imam-ul-Haq and Fakhar Zaman are the openers for Pakistan. West Indies players take knee in support of the Black Lives Matter movement. Jayden Seales to start with the ball. Here we go...

West Indies (Playing XI) - Shai Hope (WK), Kyle Mayers, Shamarh Brooks, Nicholas Pooran (C), Rovman Powell, Keacy Carty (In for Brandon King), Keemo Paul (In for Alzarri Joseph), Romario Shepherd, Akeal Hosein, Hayden Walsh, Jayden Seales (In for Anderson Phillip).

Pakistan (Playing XI) - Fakhar Zaman, Imam-ul-Haq, Babar Azam (C), Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Shadab Khan, Mohammad Haris, Khushdil Shah, Mohammad Nawaz, Hasan Ali (In for Haris Rauf), Shahnawaz Dahani (On debut) (In for Shaheen Afridi), Mohammad Wasim.
TOSS - Pakistan have won the toss and they will BAT first!

Pakistan were coming as favorites on this tour and they are 5-0 up currently overall. In the first match, they showed their batting depth while in the second we saw their spinners run riot through the Windies lineup. This young West Indies team have learned many things from this tour and all three departments need some boost. Their bowling has been decent but other than Shai Hope and Shamarh Brooks, no one has contributed much on the batting side. They will hope for one last time in this scorching Multan heat, they go home with some positivity and avoid a whitewash. Stay tuned for the toss and other updates.
